en: Black‑and‑white historic view of an elegant European spa town with ornate multi‑storey facades along a narrow river or canal. A colonnaded promenade with statues on its roof runs on the right side, crowded with well‑dressed people in early‑20th‑century fashion. Hills with villas rise in the background. Visible shopfronts and signage include a clearly readable sign for a pharmacy on a building in the distance.
